tools.name: sync_flag_to_edge_service
tools.description: Reads a feature flag's current configuration from the local flag store and posts it to the edge config service so the edge copy matches.

params.name: flag_key
params.description: Key of the feature flag to publish

params.name: environment
params.description: Environment name such as staging or production

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("flag-sync")

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("FLAGS_DB", "flags.db")
EDGE_URL = os.environ.get("EDGE_CONFIG_URL", "https://edge-config.internal/v1/flags")


@mcp.tool()
def sync_flag_to_edge_service(flag_key: str, environment: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT enabled, rollout_percent, rules FROM flags WHERE key = ? AND environment = ?",
            (flag_key, environment),
        ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return f"Flag {flag_key} not found in {environment}"
    payload = {
        "key": flag_key,
        "environment": environment,
        "enabled": bool(row[0]),
        "rollout_percent": row[1],
        "rules": row[2],
    }
    with requests.Session() as session:
        session.headers.update({"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['EDGE_TOKEN']}"})
        resp = session.put(f"{EDGE_URL}/{flag_key}", json=payload, timeout=10)
    if resp.status_code >= 400:
        return f"Edge service rejected sync: {resp.status_code}"
    return f"Synced {flag_key} to edge for {environment}"
